48701.meaning1: will explain; will define; will describe (something to)
48701.meaning2: will explain; will defines; will describes
48701.construction: vi > vy > by + ā + khissa + ti

examples.text: tesaṃ vo ahaṃ byakkhissaṃ, anupubbaṃ yathātathaṃ, jātivibhaṅgaṃ pāṇānaṃ, aññam'aññāhi jātiyo.

48702.commentary: (DNa) byagā me'ti viagā'ti byagā, vigato niruddho me attā'ti attho.

examples.text: adukkham'asukhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamānassa eso me attā'ti hoti. tassā'y'eva adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya nirodhā byagā me attā'ti hoti.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirutamhi kānane, dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ, kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virādhaya, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ… sunakhehi vā khajjamānaṃ byagghehi vā khajjamānaṃ dīpīhi vā khajjamānaṃ siṅgālehi vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ

rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa… caturāsīti rathasahassāni ahesuṃ sīhacamma-parivārāni byagghacamma-parivārāni dīpicamma-parivārāni paṇḍukambalaparivārāni sovaṇṇ'ālaṅ'kārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni vejayanta-ratha-ppamukhāni

48707.commentary: (MNt) hatth'attharaṇā hatthirūpavicittā. ass'attharaka-sīh'attharak'ādayo'pi assasīharūp'ādivicittā eva attharakā, citt'attharakaṃ nānārūpehi c'eva nānāvidhamālākamm'ādīhi ca vicittaṃ attharakaṃ.

48708.commentary: (ANa) byagghapajjā'ti te ālapanto evam'āha. kolanagarassa hi kolarukkhe hāretvā katattā kolanagaran'ti ca byagghapathe māpitattā byagghapajjan'ti ca dve nāmāni. etesañ'ca pubbapurisā tattha vasiṃsū'ti byagghapajjavāsitāya byagghapajjavāsino byagghapajjā'ti vuccanti. te ālapanto evam'āha.

examples.text: cattār'imāni, byagghapajjā, pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātāni sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.

48712.meaning1: remains of a tiger kill; tiger's leftovers

48713.construction:
byaggha > byagghī + nisā + a
byagghīnisā + a
48713.commentary: (SNa) byagghīnisā pañcasatā'ti byagghasadisā ekacce migā byagghīnisā nāma, tesaṃ byagghīnisārūpakānaṃ pañcasatāni
48713.notes: In Jātaka, the variant byagghinasa occurs among a list of birds. The commentary there glosses it as senā, a hawk.

examples.text: tayo supaṇṇā caturo ca haṃsā, byagghīnisā pañcasatā ca jhāyino, ta'y'idaṃ vimānaṃ jalate ca brahme, obhāsayaṃ uttar'assaṃ disāyan'ti.

48714.commentary: (DNa) atthena atthaṃ, byañjanena byañjanan'ti atthena saha atthaṃ, byañjanena'pi saha byañjanaṃ samānentehī'ti attho.

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, cunda, ye vo mayā dhammā abhiññā desitā, tattha sabbeh'eva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ
iccā'ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ, iccā'ti.

yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
tesaṃ no, bhante, āyasmatā mahākaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhatto'ti
byañjanaṃ kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atināmeti.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃsīlo evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño sālīnaṃ ce'pi piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjati vicitakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, n'ev'assa taṃ hoti antarāyāya.

48719.meaning1: detail; aspect; sign; mark; indication; characteristic
48719.commentary: (NIDD2) oropayitvā gihibyañjanānī'ti gihibyañjanāni vuccanti kesā ca massū ca mālā ca gandhañ'ca vilepanañ'ca ābharaṇañ'ca pilandhanañ'ca vatthañ'ca pārupanañ'ca veṭhanañ'ca ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ ādāsaṃ añjanaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ mukhacuṇṇaṃ mukhalepanaṃ hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāḷikaṃ khaggaṃ chattaṃ citr'upāhanaṃ uṇhīsaṃ maṇiṃ vāḷabījaniṃ odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni iti vā.

examples.text: oropayitvā gihibyañjanāni, sañchinnapatto yathā koviḷāro, chetvāna vīro gihibandhanāni, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

48720.meaning1: with the characteristic; having the attribute
48720.construction:
vi > vy > by + √añj + ana + ka
byañjana + ka

48721.meaning2: skilled in the letter; skilled in grammar

examples.text: idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu atthakusalo ca hoti, dhammakusalo ca, byañjanakusalo ca, niruttikusalo ca, pubb'āparakusalo ca. ettāvatā kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, suggahitaggāhī ca, bahuñ'ca gaṇhāti, gahitañ'c'assa nappamussatī'ti.

48722.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of byañjana
48722.meaning1: with regard to ways of phrasing; in expression; in letter
48722.construction:
vi > vy > by + √añj + ana + to
byañjana + to
48722.commentary: (MNa) atthato c'eva nānaṃ byañjanato cā'ti ettha kāyo'va satipaṭṭhānaṃ vedanā'va satipaṭṭhānan'ti vutte atthato nānaṃ hoti, satipaṭṭhānā'ti vutte pana byañjanato nānaṃ nāma hoti. (ANa) no byañjanato'ti byañjanaṃ pan'assa pavattati na pariyādiyati.

examples.text: tatra ce tumhākaṃ evam'assa, imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato c'eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānan'ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ suvacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evam'assa vacanīyo, āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c'eva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.

atthi, bhikkhave, vādī atthato pariyādānaṃ gacchati, no byañjanato, atthi, bhikkhave, vādī byañjanato pariyādānaṃ gacchati, no atthato, atthi, bhikkhave, vādī atthato ca byañjanato ca pariyādānaṃ gacchati, atthi, bhikkhave, vādī n'ev'atthato no byañjanato pariyādānaṃ gacchati.

48723.meaning1: who is skilled in the marks and signs

examples.text: satta c'ussade idh'ādhigacchati, hatthapādamudutañ'ca vindati, āhu byañjananimittakovidā, khajjabhojjarasalābhitāya naṃ.

48724.meaning1: who bears the (knowledge of) signs and markings

examples.text: veditvā so sucaritassa phalaṃ, uṇhīsasīsattam'idh'ajjhagamā, byākaṃsu byañjananimittadharā, pubbaṅ'gamo bahujanaṃ hessati.
byañjan'antassa dhātussa co hoti chapaccayesu paresu. jigucchati, tikicchati, jighacchati.
byañjan'antassa dhātussa ko hoti khapaccaye pare. titikkhati, bubhukkhati.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitehi sutt'antehi (na) byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca anulomenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya, bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.

48728.meaning1: right measure of sauce; curry in the correct proportion
48728.commentary: (MNa) byañjanamattāyā'ti byañjanassa mattā nāma odanato catuttho bhāgo.

examples.text: byañjanaṃ kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo byañjanamattāya āhāreti, na ca byañjanena ālopaṃ atināmeti.

48729.meaning1: sweetness of sound; smoothness of words; sweetly worded language

48731.meaning1: (gram) sticking together of letters; adhesion of syllables

examples.text: iccā'ti padasandhi padasaṃsaggo padapāripūrī akkharasamavāyo byañjanasiliṭṭhatā padānupubbatāpetaṃ, iccā'ti.

48732.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of byañjana
48732.meaning1: letter by letter; syllable by syllable; word by word
48732.construction:
vi > vy > by + √añj + ana + so
byañjana + so

examples.text: addhamās'ūpasampannena me, āvuso, atthapaṭisambhidā sacchikatā odhiso byañjanaso. tam'ahaṃ anekapariyāyena ācikkhāmi desemi paññāpemi paṭṭhapemi vivarāmi vibhajāmi uttānīkaromi.
āyasmato dhammarakkhitassa santike tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ eken'eva uddesena tīhi māsehi byañjanaso pariyāpuṇitvā puna tīhi māsehi atthaso manas'ākāsi.
saṃyogato pubbe eo rassā iv'occante kvaci, anantarā byañjanā saṃyogo.
sare ṭhapetvā sesā k'ādayo niggahīt'antā byañjanā.

48734.meaning1: well-versed in the letter; knowledgeable in phrasing
48734.commentary: (DNa) atth'upetan'ti atthena upetaṃ atthassa viññātāraṃ. byañjan'upetan'ti byañjanehi upetaṃ byañjanānaṃ viññātāraṃ. (NPa) byañjan'upetan'ti sabhāvaniruttisamupetaṃ.

examples.text: tassa sādhū'ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ, tassa sādhū'ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā so evam'assa vacanīyo, lābhā no āvuso, suladdhaṃ no āvuso, ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma evaṃ atth'upetaṃ byañjan'upetan'ti.

48738.meaning1: experienced; learned; competent; trained; (comm) with clear understanding

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ, āvuso, etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi, yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.

48739.meaning1: more experienced; more learned; more competent
48739.construction:
vi > vy > by + √añj + ta + tara
byatta + tara

examples.text: teh'ānanda, bhikkhūhi sabbeh'eva samaggehi sannipatitabbaṃ. sannipatitvā ekatopakkhikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ byattatarena bhikkhunā uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā saṅgho ñāpetabbo

48740.construction: vi > vy > by + ati > aty > att + √i > ay + *a

examples.text: yāvat'atthī'ti vuccatī'ti yāvatā ete cha ārammaṇā atthī'ti vuccanti. vacanabyattayo veditabbo.

cakkhu aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. rūpā aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino. itth'etaṃ dvayaṃ calañ'c'eva byathañ'ca aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ vipariṇāmi aññathābhāvi.
phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti. itth'ete'pi dhammā calā c'eva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.

48745.synonym: kampati, pariphandati, pavedhati, phandati, vikampati, vedhati, vedhatī, saṅkampati, sampakampati, sampavedhati, saṃkampati

48746.commentary: (MNa) byantam'eva naṃ akāsin'ti vigatantaṃ nissesaṃ parivaṭumaṃ paricchinnam'eva naṃ akāsiṃ.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, uppann'uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ pajaham'eva vinodam'eva byantam'eva naṃ akāsiṃ.

48747.construction:
vi > vy > by + anta + i
byanta + i

examples.text: vitakk'ūpasame ca yo rato, asubhaṃ bhāvayate sadā sato, esa kho byanti kāhiti, esa checchati mārabandhanaṃ.
so yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantiṃ kareyya
yā kāci kaṅkhā abhinandanā vā, anekadhātūsu puthū sadāsitā, aññāṇamūlappabhavā pajappitā, sabbā mayā byantikatā samūlikā.

48749.meaning1: removes; eliminates; gets rid of; puts an end to
48749.commentary: (SNa) na byantīkarotī'ti bhaṅgamattam'pi anavasesento na vigatantaṃ karoti.

examples.text: tañ'ce bhikkhu adhivāseti nappajahati na vinodeti na byantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti, veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā byantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo, āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

48752.meaning1: makes an end of; finishes; gets rid of
48752.commentary: (MNa) byantī kareyyā'ti vigat'antāni kareyya. yathā tesaṃ kākaṇikamattopi pariyanto nāma nāvasissati, evaṃ kareyya, sabbaso paṭiniyyāteyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: vitakk'ūpasame ca yo rato, asubhaṃ bhāvayate sadā sato, esa kho byanti kāhiti, esa checchati mārabandhanaṃ.
so yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantiṃ kareyya

48753.meaning1: removed; eliminated; got rid of; put an end to

examples.text: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno majjhimasahagatā upakkilesā kāmavitakko byāpādavitakko vihiṃsāvitakko, tam'enaṃ sacetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.

48754.meaning1: removes; eliminates; gets rid of; puts an end to
48754.commentary: (SNa) na byantīkarotī'ti bhaṅgamattam'pi anavasesento na vigatantaṃ karoti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti

evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno oḷārikā upakkilesā kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ, tam'enaṃ sacetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.

iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā byantībhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo, āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evaṃvādino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā.

48756.commentary: (DNa) byantībhūtan'ti niyatibhūtaṃ. nittaṇhan'ti attho. kuto? sabbaso āsavaṭṭhānīyehi dhammehi tebhūmakadhammehī'ti attho. idha bhāvetabbapade maggo kathito.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, khīṇ'āsavassa bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ vivekaṭṭhaṃ nekkhamm'ābhirataṃ byantībhūtaṃ sabbaso āsavaṭṭhāniyehi dhammehi.

48757.meaning1: is removed; is eliminated; is got rid of; is ended
48757.commentary: (SNa) na byantīkarotī'ti bhaṅgamattam'pi anavasesento na vigatantaṃ karoti.

examples.text: so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti. tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti anusayā byantīhonti.

48758.meaning1: way of speech; mode of speaking
48758.commentary: (VINa) byappatho'ti vacanapatho, vācā'y'eva hi aññesam'pi diṭṭh'ānugatim'āpajjantānaṃ pathabhūtato byappatho'ti vuccati.
48758.notes:
see PED byappatha for discussion on etymology.
ABH suggests vācā + patha

examples.text: sampajānamusāvādo nāma visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā, girā, byappatho, vacībhedo, vācasikā viññatti, aṭṭha anariyavohārā

48759.meaning1: way of speech; mode of expression
48759.commentary: (NIDD1) ky'āssa byappathayo assū'ti. kīdisena byappathena samannāgato assa kiṃsaṇṭhitena kiṃpakārena kiṃpaṭibhāgenā'ti vacīpārisuddhiṃ pucchati. (SNPa) ky'āssa byappathayo assū'ti kīdisāni tassa vacanāni assu.
48759.notes: see PED byappatha for discussion on etymology

examples.text: ky'āssa byappathayo assu, ky'āss'assu idha gocarā, kāni sīlabbatān'āssu, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

48760.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from byappeti, caus

examples.text: yo kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā vacīsaṅkhāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo ariyo anāsavo lok'uttaro maggaṅgo.

48762.construction: vi > vy > by + abhi + cara + ti

48764.commentary: (DNt) ñātibyasane yesaṃ ñātīnaṃ vināso, tesaṃ hitasukhaṃ viddhaṃseti, tasmā byasatī'ti byasanaṃ.

examples.text: tatiyapade pana ārogyavināsako rogo eva rogabyasanaṃ. so hi ārogyaṃ byasati vikkhipati vināsetī'ti byasanaṃ. rogo'va byasanaṃ rogabyasanaṃ, tena rogabyasanena.
ayo'ti sukhaṃ, na ayo anayo, dukkhaṃ. tadetaṃ sabbaso sukhaṃ byasati vikkhipatī'ti byasanaṃ. iti anayo'va byasanaṃ anayabyasanaṃ, mahādukkhan'ti attho.
evaṃ dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ tibbaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ byasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, kaṭasī vaḍḍhitā.
yo'pi c'ettha katakusalo hoti, tam'pi ñāti-roga-bhoga-byasana-ādīnaṃ aññatarena byasanena samannāgataṃ disvā vā sutvā vā tesaṃ abhāve'pi vaṭṭadukkhaṃ anatikkantattā, dukkhito'va ayan'ti.

48766.meaning1: met with disaster; suffered a calamity

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā ime pañca kāmaguṇe gathitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti, te evam'assu veditabbā, anayam'āpannā byasanam'āpannā yathākāmakaraṇīyā pāpimato.
sare'ty'asmiṃ opasilesiko kāsasattamī, tato vaṇṇakālabyavadhāne kāriyaṃ na hoti.

48770.meaning1: business activity; trading; commerce; business dealing
48770.commentary: (MNa) vohāro'ti byavahāravohāro'pi paṇṇatti'pi vacanam'pi cetanā'pi. tattha, yo hi koci manussesu, vohāraṃ upajīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, vāṇijo so na brāhmaṇo'ti. (ma. ni. 2.457) ayaṃ byavahāravohāro nāma.

48771.construction: iva > eva > veyya > veyyā > vyā > byā
48771.synonym: aho, āma, khu, kho, nāma, nūna, vata, ve, vo, sudaṃ, ha, have, hi

examples.text: evaṃbyākho ahaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, byākataṃ kho, āvuso, amhehi sabbeh'eva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ.
acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yathā taṃ sutavatā sāvakena samma'd'eva satthusāsanaṃ ājānantena, evam'eva āyasmatā puṇṇena mantāṇiputtena gambhīrā gambhīrapañhā anumassa anumassa byākatā.
maṃ ce'pi tumhe, bhikkhave, etam'atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, aham'pi taṃ evam'evaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ mahākaccānena byākataṃ
sattahi kho tvaṃ, āvuso, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato. katamehi sattahi?
tena kho pana samayena sambahulehi bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā hoti, khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāmā'ti.
te maṃ catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ upādāy'upādāya pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ, puṭṭho puṭṭho c'āhaṃ tesaṃ byākareyyaṃ, byākatañ'ca me byākatato dhāreyyuṃ, na ca maṃ dutiyakaṃ uttari paṭipuccheyyuṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti, sīlasampadāya kathāya ca āgataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, pañhabyākaraṇāni. katamāni cattāri? atthi, bhikkhave, pañho ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo, atthi, bhikkhave, pañho vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo.
pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, aññābyākaraṇāni. katamāni pañca?
[daḷhadhammo bahūsu ṭīkā ca moggallānabyākaraṇaṃ ca oloketabbaṃ]

48784.meaning1: should be answered; to be replied (to)

examples.text: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
atthi bhikkhave pañho ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyo, atthi pañho vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo, atthi pañho paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo, atthi pañho ṭhapanīyo.

kacc'āhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī c'eva bhagavato homi, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi, dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vād'ānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī'ti?
abhijānām'ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ pañhaṃ aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitāti. yathā kathaṃ pana te, mahārāja, byākariṃsu, sace te agaru bhāsassū'ti.
